item.title: A beggar knocked at Diphon Archnikidis ~261's door in Anthemoessa and was fed. In the morn
item.description: A beggar knocked at Diphon Archnikidis ~261's door in Anthemoessa and was fed. In the morning the beggar was gone, and 209 obols were under the bowl. The beggar was Archon #3999 the Twice-Born, of the Golden Race.
